name: Graveyard counts: compound count, Grist, a double-faced card's front, Boneyard Mycodrax not counting itself
notes: Abomination of Llanowar counts itself and P1's one Elf card, not the opponent's (2/2). Mortivore counts Mycodrax, two Llanowar Elves and Grist, not Invasion of Zendikar's back face (4/4). Boneyard Mycodrax in P1's graveyard, 'other creature cards in your graveyard', counts Elves and Grist (2). Memory: project_graveyard_counts_by_owner_and_kind_2026-11-22.

scryfallData.name: Abomination of Llanowar
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Vigilance; menace (This creature can't be blocked except by two or more creatures.)
Abomination of Llanowar's power and toughness are each equal to the number of Elves you control plus the number of Elf cards in your graveyard.
scryfallData.flavor_text: "Run!" screamed its living mouths. "Come!" cried its dead ones.

graveyard.oracle_text:

−5: Each opponent loses life equal to the number of creature cards in your graveyard.
